name: Lancastrian Billmen
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry (Bill/Polearm) · anti-cav · 220 leadership · T4
pitch: A bracing bill/pike line that leans on heavy bleed damage and eats cavalry charges when held still. Its two veterancy lines are a genuine fork rather than an upgrade — bleed-focused micro play versus tankier anti-cav stability — but breaking formation mid-fight or getting caught by burst/block units loses it fast.

doctrines.name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
doctrines.effect: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% DMG when HP above 60%.

doctrines.name: Anti-Cavalry Doctrine (x2)
doctrines.effect: -30% to -35% DMG taken from cavalry while bracing (tier varies by card copy).

veterancy.label: Lower line (bleed/damage)
veterancy.body: Active, micro-heavy path — rewards hitting multiple targets and short, well-timed engagements where bleed compounds; best vs infantry-heavy fights. House Q&A confirms multiple builds exist for this unit but gives no specifics.

veterancy.label: Upper line (anti-cav/defensive)
veterancy.body: Passive-stable path trading damage for survivability and control; recommended specifically vs cavalry-heavy comps, needs less constant micro but punishes poor positioning just as hard.

battleRole.positioning: Play like any pikes — hold formation around your Stalwart or current-meta shield, and be braced before cavalry arrives. {1} Never move formation mid-fight or you lose all damage. {1} Positioning discipline matters more on the upper line: held well it passively slows/disrupts pushes, but poor positioning loses either line's model line quickly regardless of stat spread. {2}
battleRole.tips: The lower line rewards short, well-timed engagements over prolonged brawling since bleed stacks compound with time; the upper line's value is control and battlefield presence rather than direct damage. {2}

cards.name: Cavalry
cards.why: countered by this unit if braced in time

cards.name: Low HP pool units
cards.why: bleed damage stacks fastest against squishy targets

controls.notes: Ability 2 — huge burst, stays braced through the animation; use on cooldown. {1}
